instruction: How many hours does the battery of Kobo Clara HD eReader last? Please answer as per its amazon reviews or questions/answers and and only trust information from its verified purchasers.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only the answer (battery hours as a number) matters. The product id is discovered by search_products; verified-purchaser battery information is gathered from both sources the instruction names: show_product_reviews(query=battery, is_verified=true) and show_product_questions(query=battery) followed by show_product_question_answers(is_verified=true). The hours value is modeled as the object battery-hours asserted by the Q&A lookup (found-battery-hours) and passed as the answer to complete_task; complete_task requires both sources to have been consulted. The amazon read APIs are public, but login (after show_account_passwords) is included per convention and gates the search; it does not alter tracked models. is_verified=true is modeled as a boolean object.
